name: sonner
description: An opinionated toast component for React.
readme: Sonner is an opinionated toast component for React. You can read more about why and how it was built here. Alternatively you can use the /ask-sonner skill to do it for you and help you with any other Sonner-related questions. Add to your app, it will be the place where all your toasts will be rendered. After that you can use toast() from anywhere in your app.
